GTA 6 cheat codes: the cheat sheet 🎮 Save this so you have it when you finish the story 📌

How: finish the main story, open the phone (D-pad up), hold L1 + R1 (LB + RB on Xbox) and press the code on the D-pad. Each cheat has its own unlock (it's under each name). Cheats turn off saving and trophies for that session, so save first.

Codes as listed by GameSpot, PC Gamer, GamesRadar, Screen Rant and Vice. Full list: vicereplay.com (link in bio)
